notes.rules: Aliases follow Rebrickable relation types P,T,M,A (child -> parent) up to 4 hops, then strip prNNNN/patNNNN; target must exist as parts/<id>.dat. Printed parts alias to their unprinted base (shape equivalent, print is lost).

source: Rebrickable parts.csv and part_relationships.csv checked against parts/*.dat of the official LDraw library; see docs/plans/done/rebrickable-mapping.md
